suppress.notes: Spring WebFlux only; no spring-webflux on the classpath (Aalto XML, functional endpoints, PartEventHttpMessageReader, Jetty 12 Core adapter, WebFlux WebSocket).
Spring MVC features the service does not use: XsltView and view rendering (REST only, no views), Server-Sent Events, functional endpoints (RouterFunction).
SpEL evaluated from user input: the service evaluates no expression from a request or a message. RSocket: not on the classpath.
Data binding of user-supplied property paths: the generated controllers bind only simple @RequestParam values and @RequestBody through Jackson; no @ModelAttribute, no DataBinder.
Spring Security features the service does not use: the embedded UnboundID LDAP server (no LDAP on the classpath), WebAuthn (not configured; the API is stateless and bearer only).
